title: Universal GUI DSL & Verification Contract Standard

rules.description: Each panel section MUST begin with an .item-section-toolbar header container.
Create/add MUST be a primary .section-add-button to the left of .item-view-switch inside .section-view-toolbar; view-switch is presentation modes only.
State changes MUST synchronize tab, section view, item_view, viewport and organization without page reload. Presentation MUST NOT be written to view=.
Control icons MUST use inline SVG elements rather than raw Unicode/Emoji characters.
viewport=tablet defaults to item_view=cards; viewport=pc defaults to table; compact viewports use a drawer and 100% width.
support MUST NOT appear as an organization-rail leaf or registry enum; tab=support aliases to tasks.
Public and app chrome share one footer.footer; SPA #root MUST NOT receive a duplicate injected footer.
Public pages MUST declare wellmanifest.gui/page/v1 page.kind (landing|marketplace|article|form|auth|panel). Toolbar/Add-left rules apply only when kind=panel.
Observed page.kind MUST match page.intentKind when intent is set (GUI-PAGE-KIND-001).
Observed font/color/size counts MUST stay within page_profiles[kind].visualBudgets.
